title: mime-tree: define public types
description: All other mime-tree modules depend on these types; they define the public API contract. Define in part.rs: ParsedPart (part_id, content_type, charset, transfer_encoding, disposition, filename, cid, header_range, body_range, children), TransferEncoding enum (Identity|QuotedPrintable|Base64|SevenBit|EightBit|Binary), ParsedHeader (name, value). In message.rs: ParsedMessage (part_index, text_body, html_body, attachments, headers, preview, warnings). All Serialize+Deserialize, owned, no lifetime params.
acceptance_criteria: All types compile with #[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]; no lifetime parameters on any public type
